# Aski

> A public, pre-1.0 Swift library and macOS CLI for local image-to-character-art conversion. Convert once to ASCIIGrid, then render text, attributed text, or CGImage. Swift 6.3+; iOS 18+, macOS 15+, visionOS 2+; strict Swift 6 concurrency; Apache 2.0.

These links follow `main`. When editing a branch, read the matching files in that
checkout. Current source, tests, `Package.swift`, and `justfile` define the implemented
surface; dated research and old task plans are evidence, not current API contracts.

## Work in the repository

- [Agent instructions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/AGENTS.md): Start here for hard rules, the startup route, and local gate expectations.
- [Task-to-code navigation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/agents/navigation.md): Map a requested change to source, tests, and user docs; includes scoped search recipes and sources of truth.
- [Validation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/agents/validation.md): Checks by change type, native vs portable limits, build-once gate ordering, and generated artifacts.
- [Contributing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Setup, recorded snapshot toolchain, documentation conventions, PRs, and releases.
- [Documentation hub](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/README.md): Human-readable navigation and canonical ownership of each documentation surface.
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/architecture.md): Current conversion pipeline, component ownership, CLI contracts, dependencies, and implementation boundaries.
- [Tooling](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/agents/tooling.md): Current commands, research labs, generators, compatibility shims, and source ownership.
- [Package manifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Package.swift): Authoritative Swift minimum, platforms, products, targets, and dependencies.
- [Build recipes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/justfile): Authoritative local build/test/docs/release commands; Makefile forwards to just.
- [Source map](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/repo-map.generated.md): Generated top-level declarations in Sources/Aski only; not a tools/tests index.
- [Backlog workflow](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/agents/backlog.md): Query branch-local tasks with --plain and edit only through the backlog CLI.

## Use Aski

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/README.md): Product overview, bundled-image demo, package installation, exact pins, and release boundaries.
- [Swift Package Index](https://swiftpackageindex.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski): Package page with releases, Swift-version and platform build results, and hosted DocC API documentation.
- [API catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Sources/Aski/Aski.docc/Aski.md): DocC public symbol and article navigation; source uses DocC-specific links.
- [Getting Started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Sources/Aski/Aski.docc/GettingStarted.md): Load a CGImage, convert once, choose an output, and configure a character set.
- [CLI guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Sources/Aski/Aski.docc/CommandLine.md): Render, inspect, discovery, masks, PNG widths, manifests, and troubleshooting.
- [Examples and recipes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/guides/character-art-recipes.md): Source/output comparison and three explicit CLI treatments.
- [Rendering](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Sources/Aski/Aski.docc/Rendering.md): Text, attributed text, raster color, aspect, and exact-width contracts.
- [Character sets](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Sources/Aski/Aski.docc/CharacterSets.md): Built-in and custom glyph sets, snapshot semantics, and expert matcher arrays.
- [Algorithms](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Sources/Aski/Aski.docc/Algorithms.md): logPolar/dotMatrix, knob relevance, sampling, and measured limitations.
- [Palette matching](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Sources/Aski/Aski.docc/PaletteMatching.md): Default OKLab metric and explicitly experimental alternatives.
- [Masking](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Sources/Aski/Aski.docc/Masking.md): Coverage, fallbacks, active-region grounds, and composition.
- [Effects](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Sources/Aski/Aski.docc/Effects.md): Composition, lighting, effects, async rendering, and capability-dependent fallback.
- [Animation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Sources/Aski/Aski.docc/Animation.md): Time-based frames and patterns from one conversion.
- [Video and GIF](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Sources/Aski/Aski.docc/Video.md): Library round-trips, resampling, and streaming; CLI harnesses are labs.
- [Tiles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Sources/Aski/Aski.docc/Tiles.md): Pixel-art, brick, and mosaic grid output.
- [Duotone](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Sources/Aski/Aski.docc/Duotone.md): A complete recipe composed from public converter and renderer APIs.
- [Migration notes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Sources/Aski/Aski.docc/Migrating-to-A1.md): Current breaking changes plus clearly labeled historical transitions.
- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/CHANGELOG.md): Unreleased and versioned source/output changes.
- [Distribution](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/guides/distribution.md): Relocatable CLI candidate packaging, resources, provenance, and hosted-doc configuration.

## Automation contracts

- [Inspection schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/assets/schemas/aski-inspect-v1.schema.json): Versioned inspect JSON; readers tolerate additive fields.
- [CLI metadata schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/assets/schemas/aski-metadata-v1.schema.json): Versioned command-discovery JSON from aski metadata.
- [Render manifest schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/assets/schemas/aski-render-manifest-v1.schema.json): Unsigned render record with paths and optional mask state; not an authenticity proof.

## Research and evidence

- [Research navigation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/agents/research.md): Current decision map and routes to active, adopted, rejected, inconclusive, and retired work; inspect task state before restarting an experiment.
- [Research index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/Research/README.md): Catalog of dated protocols, results, corpora, negative findings, and retractions.
- [Research index JSON](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/Research/index.json): Generated machine-readable research and result-store registry.
- [Research methodology](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/agents/research-methodology.md): Frozen controls, exact sampling lattices, pre-registered gates, and no-harm census.
- [Benchmark validation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/benchmark-validation.md): Complete capture, required metrics, allocator provenance, and retained evidence; valid does not mean fast.
- [Paired benchmarks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/agents/paired-benchmarks.md): Repeated-run comparisons, noise, portable replay, and adoption limits.
- [Design](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/DESIGN.md): Descriptor lineage and measured constraints; research proposals are separate from implemented architecture.
- [Rendering groundwork](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/agents/rendering-groundwork.md): Read current status before historical animation, mask-rendering, and fallback-noise protocols.
- [Brightness groundwork](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/agents/brightness-pool-groundwork.md): Read current status before historical exact shortlist probes and rejected heap-selection work.
- [HDR research SPI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Sources/Aski/Aski.docc/HDRRendering.md): Research-only extended-range output; not ordinary public API.
- [Discoveries](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/Research/Discoveries.md): Cross-cutting findings awaiting triage.
- [Historical research plan](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/research-plan.md): Retained planning context, not the live work queue or current implementation map.

## Interpretation notes

- Public APIs, experimental policies, research SPI, and labs have different readiness levels. Do not promote an experiment from documentation alone.
- The live work queue is the checked-in backlog on the selected branch. A completed performance task can record a rejected candidate.
- Gates are local; this repository has no hosted CI workflow. Portable documentation/script checks do not establish native build, rendering, or performance validity.
- Public history starts at v0.7.0. Earlier tags, issue numbers, and SHAs may refer to private development; retained commands are not public replay guarantees.
- Research data, corpus manifests, frozen protocols, negative results, and asset attribution are retained as evidence. Generated research indexes and the source map must be regenerated from their inputs.
